notes.title: Ludopolis crowdfunding campaign has started
notes.notes:
After 1 year of having the idea of reworking Undervault in my head, I'm happy to announce that the crowdfunding campaign is live. To celebrate the start of the campaign we are making Undervault (Ludopolis predecessor) completely free. You can try it here -  [url=https://angrykid.itch.io/undervault]the link[/url].

:cozyrealmroyale: :cozyrealmroyale: :cozyrealmroyale:

Even if you have no plans of baking Ludopolis you might find the page interesting because I'm revealing much more details about the future game. So please check it out (you may find the link on the Undervault page).
